limitations: Descriptive unequal workloads, no randomized or matched current manual arm
Root window cost includes judgment and unrelated/concurrent activity; linked-call cost is association, not isolated bookkeeping
Time is a recorded response-latency proxy, not isolated active thinking time
Closed task window excludes final ACK, objective-end accounting and later reporting tails
Inline Python counts cover decoded cmd literals with Python heredocs; unresolved values are reported, not assumed empty
State-file receipt mtimes establish local persistence, not receipt delivery
Packet authorship before dispatch is excluded unless batched into the dispatch cell; comparisons excluding that cell are also necessary

reviews.start_basis: first linked dispatch/preparation tool cell within 15 minutes before native start
